subcategory_text: Protect training, validation, and evaluation datasets from unauthorized access, tampering, and data poisoning, with provenance and integrity verification.
implementation_examples: Capture dataset provenance (source, licence, hash) in a dataset card
Sign and checksum datasets in storage
Detect dataset anomalies (statistical drift, label tampering) before training
assessment_objectives: Determine whether datasets have provenance and integrity protection.
Determine whether dataset tampering is detected.
